units.env_steps: cumulative real environment steps (every move, including wall bumps), through the snapshot
units.updates: cumulative Q-value updates: one per real step for Q-learning, plus trace updates (Q(lambda)) or planning updates (Dyna-Q)
units.budget: a snapshot at a budget is taken at the end of the first episode whose cumulative real steps reach the budget, when the per-episode greedy evaluation happens
units.step: a snapshot at a step is taken immediately after that real step's update, mid-episode
units.episode: a snapshot at an episode is taken at that episode's end
